routing: Device owner tenant and application -> JBM active tenant_admin/iot_admin roles -> distinct active users with unexpired membership in that tenant. No implicit superadmin recipient.
ownership: IoT outbox uses persisted owner tenant; rejects mismatched event metadata. JBM resolves users against its own directory; no IoT database privileges expanded.
retry: Unresolved tenant administrator or directory lookup failure is deferred to a durable 5 minute RabbitMQ TTL queue. Partial delivery exceptions retain completed recipient IDs; retry skips completed users and checks current roles again.
history: Pending legacy IoT outbox events use tenant audiences; queued/sent history is not replayed, moved or deleted.
